description: Return a price quote for a service at a business. An exact configured price can create a time-limited offer, a new one on each call, when list_services marks offer_available. Pass its offer_id to reserve_slot; the offer alone confirms no booking or payment. Configured ranges return a range with no offer. Unmatched or unpriced services return no price and no offer; ask the business for its price through the route from get_booking_destination. No AI estimates are generated. A business that sells goods through its own store answers reason goods_store with no offer: a listed item with its stored price, which can lag the store, and an unlisted item with no price and no estimate. Nothing there can be paid for through Advocate. Use this when a user asks 'how much does X cost?' or 'what's the price for Y?'.
name: get_quote

expires_at.description: Offer expiry (Unix seconds); the quoted price is guaranteed until then

offer.description: Server-minted immutable price offer for an eligible calendar booking. Only exact configured service prices can mint one; an offer is not a payment or a confirmed booking.

title: Get Price Quote
